cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Affectionate Resentment
cards.instruction: Remain warm and familiar while letting old resentment sharpen beneath every caring gesture.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Here's your tea, love. Exactly right, even without a birthday reminder. Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've brought cake. A month late, I know.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Your favourite, too. I'll warm your plate; I've kept the candle ready.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Put it in. I'll sing now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Come closer, love. I'll shield the flame. We don't want it stopping halfway through like last year's birthday call.

mechanism: A directs a belated birthday tea, accommodating B cake and singing while each act of care carries a reminder of prior neglect.
confusable: Unlike open anger or pure care, affection and grievance stay intertwined; borrowed authority adjusts the celebration around B offered participation.
comparison: Belated cake and singing differ from intimate warming after a cold wait.
seedUse: Use D93-a tea/late cake/favorite/candle and S02-a adapting the practical plan; avoid an unprepared second grievance only in the ending.
